question: How does the supreme lord set the lower powers into motion?
premises: He impels the pervading one by his own shakti.
Below, as an instrument, stands māyā in the form of action.
Below that is the coiled shakti, kuṇḍalinī.
inference: The supreme lord impels the pervading one through his own shakti, while māyā functions below as the instrument of action and kuṇḍalinī lies below that.
plain_english: He impels the pervading one by his own shakti. Below, māyā stands as the instrument in the form of action, and below that is the coiled shakti, kuṇḍalinī.
